svg.title: What Claude Code loads into a session
svg.desc: Three sources feed a Claude Code session's context. CLAUDE.md files, written and maintained by you, load at startup across managed, user, project, and local scopes. Auto memory, MEMORY.md plus topic files that Claude Code writes as it works, also loads at startup and is updated from the session. One-off context passed on the command line lasts only for that session.
svg.text: // WHAT CLAUDE CODELOADS INTO A SESSION
